newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ONIC raises maize export forecast - draft.
newsitem.headline: French ONIC raises maize export forecast - draft.

text.p: French grain office is proposing to lift its forecast for 1996/97 maize exports to other European Union states to 6.435 million tonnes from a previous forecast of 6.0 million tonnes, draft figures showed on Thursday.
Preliminary figures for a monthly report due to be released next week, seen by Reuters, also suggest a lower maize carryout than previously expected at 2.519 million tonnes.
The figures are draft ones only and can be changed before publication on March 12.

ONIC has slightly raised its 1996 crop figure to 14.28 million tonnes and has shaved 52,000 tonnes off on-farm consumption, leaving its estimate for the delivered harvest 120,000 tonnes higher than previously forecast at 12.42 million.
